lines.text: Focal Point or Centre of Interest
trees but they did not stop you. This onejsvery beautiful. You want to draw
or paint it. According to the principles of composition, you have learned in
class 6th, this tree will have a certain position on your sheet. It will not cover
the whole page. There may be other trees, houses, rocks etc here and there
which you may not be very interested in. In this case you need not to paint
everything as it is. Because you were caught by the beauty of that particular
tree, you will like to make it more prominent than other objects. Thus that
tree will be your focal point or centre of interest. In other words, the focal
point or centre of interest is the area in a composition that attracts your eye
